_comment: Two cron jobs, deliberately. Vercel's Hobby plan allows at most two, each
running no more often than once a day, and it rejects the whole DEPLOYMENT
when that is exceeded rather than just ignoring the extra one.
A third entry for /api/cron/webhooks was added here and silently blocked
every deployment after it for hours: the build never reached production and
the only symptom was a feature that would not appear.
/api/cron/webhooks still exists and works. It is driven from the
trial-reminders run below until the plan is confirmed. On Pro, give it its
own entry at */5 * * * * and remove the call from there.
